about: A deliverable can't read its own check (chapter 6 § 6.6.3). The consult note is gated by the check all_sections, and the package has a second check, notes_covered, gating nothing. Invalid: the note writes all_sections' message. Valid: notes_covered's.
sentences: Deliverable 'consult' reads check.all_sections, which checks consult: a deliverable can't read its own check.
